messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: PraxisHealth (enterprise-dedicated) reporting elevated 5xx errors in eu-central-1. Incident ID INC-2026-0421. Initial spike observed at 12:22 UTC.
sam: grabbing oncall. paging primary now.
oncall: I have the page, looking at router and rate-limit logs.
sam: @matt @renee @olivia pls stand by for customer-facing copy. olivia is the AM.
renee: reaching out to AMs. do we know scope? single customer vs multiple accounts under Praxis?
olivia: AM says two production orgs seeing failures, non-prod looks fine. They want clear severity wording for their ops team.
matt: quick check — dedicated fallback didn't kick. autoscaler shows no new nodes; suspect rate-limiter regression after last config deploy.
oncall: sharing logs snippet: ```
$ kubectl -n redwood get pods | grep praxis
praxis-gw-0   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  3        12m
router-xy    1/1 Running           5        2d
```
oncall: router logs show 429 -> 5xx cascade when limiter returns 503 on overflow. rolling a config patch now.
sam: draft for customer (short): 
"PraxisHealth — We are currently investigating increased 5xx errors for model requests in the eu-central-1 region affecting your production orgs. Our engineers have identified an issue with request rate-limiting configuration and are rolling a fix. No customer data has been exposed. We will provide updates every 10–15 minutes and a tailored post-incident summary."
renee: change "rolling a fix" -> "deploying a rollback to the previous rate-limiter config while we validate" (more precise). add expected ETA 15–25m.
lia: contact routing for this thread: primary AM = olivia, secondary = jordan, SE on-call = matt, CS escalation = cs-enterprise@redwood.com. Use escalation phone list if not acked in 5m.
olivia: agreed. I'll call the Praxis ops lead after the first public update (they asked us to call at first update).
matt: executing rollback — applying canary to routers now. command: ```
$ kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/router RATE_LIMIT_PROFILE=stable-canary
$ kubectl -n redwood rollout status deployment/router --timeout=120s
```
oncall: canary applied to 20% of pods at 12:28 UTC. monitoring metrics.
matt: seeing reduced 5xx on canary pods, initiating full rollout.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation deployed to 100% at 12:32 UTC. 5xx rate fell from peak ~12% to ~1.4%. Marking INC-2026-0421 status: Mitigated (P1 -> P2).
renee: draft status page entry to post: 
{"impact":"partial outage","summary":"Increased 5xx errors for PraxisHealth in eu-central-1 — mitigation in progress","updates":[{"body":"Engineers deployed rollback of rate-limiter configuration; error rates decreasing. Next update in 10 minutes.","time":"2026-04-21T12:32:00Z"}]}
sam: I'll post that via internal status API and send the email to the Praxis distribution list (AM + ops). CURL to status API: ```
curl -X POST https://internal-status.redwood/api/incidents 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STATUS_API_TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"service":"infra-gateway","summary":"PraxisHealth: elevated 5xx in eu-central-1","impact":"partial outage"}'
```
olivia: sending the phone call to the Praxis ops lead now. i'll paste the short customer message into the call notes.
jordan: compiling the list of affected endpoints and client retry guidance; will attach to the post-incident report.
oncall: confirming post-rollback metrics: 5xx steady at ~1.1% over 5m. latency normal.
matt: rolling monitoring alerts back to normal thresholds.
sam: note for comms: include "no customer data exposure" and expected full resolution note + PM for tailored postmortem. legal@redwood on standby.
renee: assigning follow-ups: matt — create a short writeup of the config regression; oncall — add timeline & logs; olivia/jordan — customer outreach & verbatim notes. deadline for initial postmortem draft: EOD today.
incident-bot: REMINDER: file postmortem and link to INC-2026-0421.
sam: thanks team. keeping this thread open for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
jordan: will confirm once Praxis confirms service health on their side.
olivia: Praxis ops just replied — green on their end. they appreciated the quick call. :thumbsup:
sam: closing the fire stage, moving this to 'follow-up'. updating thread title (internal) and creating follow-up ticket. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
